page.notes: The top of the scan is shaded and the running head is partly cut off; the right side of each line is cut off, so the ends of some lines are incomplete. Only the visible text is transcribed. Printed "Rerum" heading fragment is partly visible. The scan is cut off at the left and right, so most entries end partway through a line; the cut-off ends are left as they stand. The ornament at lower left is a woodcut decoration, not text. Doubtful: "{C}" stands for a large cut-off initial letter; "I S." is a partly visible word. The visible strip shows only the right ends of the lines; the left parts of the text are not in this part of the scan. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed. Some line ends are partly unclear and are not marked further, and the line breaks shown with lb are not part of the printed text. Paragraph divisions are inferred from the gaps between groups of lines.
